resources.string: Better Type checks what you type in other apps
Grammar and spell checking for every text field, running entirely on your device. Choose Better Type under System → Keyboard → Spell checker.

Texts are checked in the text field\'s language. If a text is clearly written in another of the languages switched on here, it is checked in that one. Every language stays loaded and takes 50–270 MB of memory (German the most).
